title: torenia cordifolia
intro: Torenia cordifolia, commonly known as Blue Skyflower, is a plant species native to tropical Asia and belongs to the family Scrophulariaceae. It has been traditionally used in folk medicine to treat various health issues, including fever, cough, and respiratory problems, due to its multiple health benefits such as anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Torenia cordifolia include its ability to act as an expectorant, antipyretic, and anti-inflammatory agent, which helps in relieving respiratory symptoms and reducing fever. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
